intro: Ivar's Head is the gruesome proof of the destruction of the ravenous ghoul Ivar the Foul in Silverpine Forest. It is sought by the Deathstalker Rane Yorick to ensure safe recovery for her wounded brother Quinn.

p: While scouting northern Silverpine Forest on the orders of High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken Deathstalkers Rane and Quinn Yorick were ambushed at an abandoned farmstead by a feral ghoul known as Ivar the Foul. Though the siblings managed to fend off the fiend, Quinn was severely mauled in the confrontation. Stranded at the ruined farm while her brother recovered, Rane could not safely leave Quinn unattended to complete their mission. Severing Ivar's head provides definitive proof that the beast will never terrorize the estate again, granting Quinn the necessary time to recuperate under Rane's watchful eye.
